{{summary | book=7 |
|chapter=13
|title=The Bowl of the Winds
|icon=Gulls
|setting=[[Ebou Dar]] Harbor
}}

{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}

Aviendha is on a boat with [[Elayne]], [[Nynaeve]], and [[Birgitte]], trying to grasp in her mind the vast amounts of water that make up an ocean. They worry a bit since being warned by Egwene that [[Moghedien]] escaped, but they resolve to just be careful. Aviendha suggests they rely on [[Mat|Mat's]] [[ta'veren]] abilities to help find the bowl. Nynaeve immediately rejects the idea but Elayne considers it to be a good idea and asks Birgitte to broach the subject with Mat. They arrive at the largest [[Sea Folk]] ship in the harbor and prepare to board. The Sea Folk do not wish to allow [[Aes Sedai]] on their ship but Elayne tells them that they already know that the [[Windfinder]]s can [[channel]].

Aviendha finds the jewelry worn by the Sea Folk to be very strange, especially the nose rings. [[Malin din Toral Breaking Wave]] is the [[Wavemistress]] for clan [[Somarin]]. They move to a cabin where they encounter [[Nesta din Reas Two Moons]], the [[Mistress of the Ships|Mistress of Ships]] for the Atha'an Miere. Nynaeve attempts to bully them but Elayne intervenes and asks for channelers to help fix the weather when they find the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' bowl. When Elayne describes the bowl, the Sea Folk identify it as the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. The Sea Folk begin working on terms of a bargain for their aid with the Bowl of the Winds and the shorefolk are way out of their depth.
